publicTool.name: generate_visual
publicTool.label: Visual Generate
publicTool.description: Generate or edit images, mockups, posters, logos, or videos.
publicTool.capability: Generate or edit images and videos
publicTool.actualVideoEditingSupport: Text-to-video only in this release service; image/mask video editing inputs are rejected. Preserve the manifest wording without claiming implemented image-to-video editing.
promptGuidelines: Call for image, mockup, poster, logo, animation, or video requests.
For edits, pass local paths in sourceImages.
Claim success only after a file path is returned.

model.meaning: provider/model or unqualified exact model id; empty for auto

publicTool.execution: Use current native ctx.cwd() and actual session identity. Ignore any extra user-supplied cwd field. Keep optional/inactive in release hot loadout; discover_tools metadata and call_tool execute the real definition. Do not replace the image_assets tool.
publicTool.callback: Await onGeneratedFile(result), swallow only archive callback failure so a successfully saved file is never discarded or regenerated.

migration.semantics: Apply one-time default migration; preserve a user's later disabled state.

setPreference.body: bodyJson; input?.model. String(requested||'').trim(); empty removes only that kind preference; explicit valid model stores canonical provider/id; invalid model does not write.
setPreference.persist: pisper.json.visualDefaultModels, shared canonical writer preserving unknown fields and concurrent writes
setPreference.response: same six-field combined image/video status envelope

test.prompt: a small friendly robot mascot waving, flat vector illustration, soft pastel colors, plain background
test.options: default auto/model fallback, no explicit selected model or source inputs

preview.largeOrUnreadable: empty string; file generation remains success

test.archive: No tool onGeneratedFile callback in this API path; do not silently claim it is a workspace/chat generation.

api.responseTransport: Root existing same-origin/auth/error handler applies; release json responses use no-store and application/json; charset=utf-8. Invalid :kind should miss the where-constrained route.

catalogue.readPolicy: readJson only defaults ENOENT/ENOTDIR; corrupt JSON and other IO errors propagate. Current image-only reader accepts JSONC/BOM and imposes 16MiB/object-only limits; this is not the same reader.
catalogue.kindPolicy: Never infer image/video capability from model id. definition.kind || runtime.pisperKind -> inferModelKind; explicit valid capabilities ['chat','image','video'] override kind. The candidate's kind is the requested image/video kind.
catalogue.providerUnion: models.json provider keys, followed by runtime.getProviders ids; per provider models union configured definitions then runtime models. Preserve insertion ordering and stable sorting.
catalogue.enabled: Skip app.disabledProviders. Require nonempty credential from auth.json. No additional enabled/excludedModel checks appear directly in this catalog; do not invent a stronger filter without reconciling provider-runtime behavior.
catalogue.credentials: String credential as-is; type api_key returns key||'' only; other objects key||token||access_token||''. Model/provider apiKey fields are not used by this catalog. Never expose credentials or headers in HTTP client models.
catalogue.driverOrder: explicit visualApi first; otherwise combined providerId/api/baseUrl/id text: google -> google-{kind}; xai/x.ai/grok -> xai-{kind}; openrouter -> image:openrouter-image or video:openai-video; otherwise openai-{kind}.
catalogue.ranking: modelScore: gpt-image-2|gpt-5.4-image +120 else gpt-image|gpt-\d.*image +105; gemini-3|imagen-4 +100; grok-imagine +95; sora-2-pro|veo-3.1 +120 else sora-2|veo-3 +105; exact provider openai +8/google +7/xai +6. Add visualProvider25/configuredDefinition2 for selection sorting; tie name.localeCompare.
catalogue.visualProvider: Explicit providerTypes truthy entry is visual iff ==visual. Otherwise nonempty configured provider.models and every explicit/inferred kind !=chat; this test does not inspect capabilities.
catalogue.dedup: key=(baseUrl trimmed, trailing slashes stripped, lowercased) + id lowercase + requested kind + driver; winner priority visualProvider*10000 + configuredDefinition*1000 + score; ties keep first.
catalogue.preference: Case-insensitive full reference moves candidate to front. Invalid stored preference leaves it stored but returns selection empty and auto-selected first candidate.
catalogue.explicitSelection: Find qualified provider/model among raw candidates before dedup, so a caller can choose another credential on a shared endpoint. Otherwise unqualified exact id among ordered/deduplicated candidates, case-insensitive; invalid -> 未找到已启用的视觉模型：${requestedModel}.
catalogue.noModels: 没有已配置并启用的${kind==='video'?'视频':'图像'}生成模型。请先在配置页添加视觉模型。

sourceFiles.operation: kind=request.kind==='video'?'video':'image'; video rejects sourceImages?.length or truthy maskPath before catalog lookup. Image operation is edit iff loaded sourceImages.length>0, else generate.
sourceFiles.paths: resolve(cwd,String(input||'').trim()) yields an absolute path; relative paths are allowed. stat follows symlinks. Valid absolute files outside cwd are allowed by release, subject to Root's actual authorized tool/session permissions.
sourceFiles.loading: Non-array inputs -> []; filter(Boolean), slice(0,8), Promise.all. stat must be regular file, size <=24MiB, MIME inferred only by extension lowercased, read bytes without raster sniff/decode. Tool schema rejects >8; direct service truncates.
sourceFiles.mask: Falsy mask ->None; otherwise same source loader and only PNG MIME accepted. Mask without source is still loaded/validated, operation remains generate, some drivers ignore it.
sourceFiles.forbiddenReuse: Do not inherit workflow/game 8MiB/source,20MiB aggregate,cwd-containment/symlink rejection,4096px or raster-decoding restrictions into this generic loader.

requestNormalization.videoAspectToSize: If no size and aspectRatio, 9:16 ->720x1280; every other ratio ->1280x720.
requestNormalization.nonGoogleImageAspectToSize: If no size and aspectRatio, 9:16 or3:4 ->1024x1536;16:9 or4:3 ->1536x1024;else1024x1024.
requestNormalization.googleImage: Do not synthesize pixel size from aspectRatio; imageConfig gets aspectRatio/imageSize only.
requestNormalization.googleVideoResolution: For google-* video, absent resolution plus size derives 1080p iff size string includes1080, else720p.

drivers.name: openai-image
drivers.request: POST base/images/generations JSON {model,prompt,n:1,size?,quality?,output_format?}; output_format defaults png only if model id matches /gpt.*image|dall-e/i.
drivers.edit: POST base/images/edits multipart; common fields, source images with original basename+MIME, one image key=image and multiple image[]=SDK array encoding; mask optional original basename+PNG.
drivers.response: data[0].b64_json -> bytes/mime per requested outputFormat (jpeg/webp/elsepng), or data[0].url -> unauthenticated download; no image data -> exact error.

drivers.name: openrouter-image
drivers.request: POST base/chat/completions JSON {model,messages:[{role:user,content:[text prompt,...image_url data URLs]}],modalities:[image],stream:false}
drivers.response: choices[0].message.images[0].image_url string or .url; data URL first, else unauthenticated download. Mask/quality/imageSize are not forwarded.

drivers.name: openai-responses-image-fallback
drivers.eligibility: Only model.api.lowercase==openai-responses, operation!=edit, Images error status404/405/501/502, and allowFallback !== false. Explicit model still allows this protocol fallback.
drivers.request: POST base/responses JSON {model,input:prompt}; no extra image_generation tool/options in release.
drivers.response: first output.type=image_generation_call. result data URL first; otherwise nonempty string interpreted as base64; otherwise image_url.url/image_url downloaded unauthenticated. remoteId=response.id.
drivers.progress: Images 接口不可用，正在通过 Responses 接口生成图片…

drivers.name: openai-video
drivers.request: SDK multipart POST base/videos fields model,prompt,seconds:String(durationSeconds)?,size?. Do not serialize this path as JSON.
drivers.poll: GET base/videos/{encoded id} every5000ms until status completed/failed; progress 视频生成中：Math.round(progress||0)%; failed message video.error.message or视频生成失败。
drivers.download: GET base/videos/{id}/content?variant=video; SDK Accept application/binary and bearer/custom headers; progress 视频已生成，正在下载…; MIME header orvideo/mp4, extension always.mp4, remoteId=id.

drivers.name: google-image
drivers.request: POST base/models/{encodeURIComponent(id removing one leading models/)}:generateContent JSON {contents:[{role:user,parts:[...inlineData sources,{text:prompt}]}],generationConfig:{responseModalities:[TEXT,IMAGE],imageConfig?:{aspectRatio?,imageSize?}}}
drivers.response: Flatten candidates.content.parts; first inlineData or inline_data with data; MIME mimeType/mime_type/elseimage/png; extension jpeg->jpg/webp->webp/elsepng. No mask/quality/outputFormat field in request.

drivers.name: google-video
drivers.poll: Require operation.name; while !done progress GoogleVeo message,5000ms waits,GET base/{name stripping leading slash}; error.message orGoogle视频生成失败。
drivers.download: Find first recursive object.uri containing video|files|download|googleapis; fetch with x-goog-api-key only; MIME header/elsevideo/mp4,extension.mp4,remoteId operation.name.

drivers.name: xai-image
drivers.edit: POST base/images/edits multipart model,prompt,repeated image parts named image-1,image-2,...,mask asmask.png,size?,quality?; no n/output_format fields in xAI edit.
drivers.response: data[0] || image || output[0] || output. b64_json/base64/image_base64 with MIME mime_type/mimeType/elsepng; else url/image_url including top-level; authenticated download bearer+model headers.

drivers.name: xai-video
drivers.request: POST base/videos/generations JSON {model,prompt,duration?,aspect_ratio?,resolution?}; on404/405 only POST base/videos JSON {model,prompt,seconds?:String(duration),size defaultlandscape/portrait}.
drivers.poll: ID task_id/request_id/id/data.task_id/data.id; recursive HTTP(S)url/video_url/download_url; status/status.state/data.status lowercase; failure states failed/error/cancelled/canceled; success completed/succeeded/done;5000ms waits; GET matching creation route, videos GET may fallback generations GET only404/405.
drivers.download: URL if present -> authenticated fetch; else id -> GET base/videos/{id}/content; MIME header/mp4; extension jpeg/jpg,webp,mp4,webm or fallback.mp4; remoteId id|null.

drivers.name: new-api-image
drivers.request: Delegates generateOpenAICompatible with same options; not xAI-image body.

drivers.name: new-api-video
drivers.request: POST base/videos JSON {model,prompt,seconds?:String(duration),size defaultlandscape/portrait}; on404/405 only POST base/video/generations JSON {model,prompt,duration?,width?,height?,response_format:url}.
drivers.poll: Same recursive HTTP(S)URL/id/status family;GET base/{chosen route}/{id} every5000ms; job errors use New API error wrapper.
drivers.download: URL or GET base/videos/{id}/content; bearer/custom headers; MIME header/mp4,webm extension iff MIME includeswebm elsemp4;remoteId id|null.
drivers.errors: duplicate field duration -> New API 视频渠道转发失败：${upstream}。请检查中转站中该模型的渠道映射或协议适配。; HTTP errors carrystatus.

detection.trigger: Only driver starts xai-; if detected choose new-api-${model.kind}; explicit new-api driver uses it directly.
detection.request: GET base URL origin root '/', remove query/hash; Accept:text/html,application/json; no provider auth headers.
detection.cache: Lowercase origin -> shared detection promise, persistent successful/false/error result until explicit cache clear. This does not run in model-status API.

retryAndBilling.layers: Keep SDK transport retry, Images->Responses protocol fallback, endpoint negotiation and model/provider fallback separate. They have different triggers.
retryAndBilling.defaults: Unqualified auto generation uses ordered models; Generic OpenAI SDK maxRetries1; image timeout180000ms,video600000ms per SDK request. Non-SDK fetch drivers have no explicit global generation timeout; polling has no fixed overall deadline beyond caller signal/consumer budget.
retryAndBilling.explicitModel: Select one model; prohibit changing model/provider, but still allow SDK retry1 and generation-only Images->Responses fallback unless allowFallback false.
retryAndBilling.noFallbackOption: options.allowFallback === false disables all model/provider fallback, OpenAI SDK retries(maxRetries0) and OpenAI Images->Responses fallback. A same-named request/body extra field does not override options.
retryAndBilling.unavailablePattern: model_not_found/unknown provider for model/unsupported model/model unavailable/no available channel|provider|model/credential cannot access model and the exact bilingual regex in index.mjs:11-12.
retryAndBilling.safety: Signal aborted or content policy/safety system/moderation/内容安全/安全策略/审核拒绝/违规内容 ->never model fallback, even retryable HTTP status.
retryAndBilling.auth: 401/403 ->cross-provider fallback iff next provider id differs; same-provider ordinary invalid-key fails. Same-provider model-specific unavailable/credential-access message can still satisfy unavailablePattern. Only examine next candidate; do not skip neighbors searching a later provider.
retryAndBilling.statusPropagation: Use driver-specific status visibility: OpenAI SDK and xAI/New API jsonRequest errors carry status; Google JSON errors, xAI edit errors and download errors do not attach status in this source. Do not accidentally make every HTTP failure model-fallback eligible.
retryAndBilling.endpointFallback: xAI/New API video404/405 route negotiation is implemented without an allowFallback gate. Report/reproduce this distinction; game paid consumers are image operations and still have no such POST negotiation path.
retryAndBilling.sdkRetryDetails: LockedSDK6.49.0: x-should-retry true/false overrides;408/409/429/>=500 and non-aborted connection/timeout errors retry while budget remains; retry-after-ms then retry-after/date else exponential 0.5s initial,8s max,0-25% jitter. No x-stainless-* outgoing headers.
retryAndBilling.gameWorkflowAdapter: Every paid sprite/action direction calls universal service with kind:image,qualified model if selected,PNG output,and allowFallback:false. Preserve completed directions and partial outputs; failed/canceled direction must not automatically generate again. Resume only remaining directions. Do not globally turn off generic tool fallback just to preserve this consumer boundary.
retryAndBilling.noReexecution: Archive/preview failure never creates a second paid job. Cancellation/timeout after a paid request does not imply it was not accepted and must not trigger a new generation automatically.

progressAndOutput.firstProgress: 使用 ${providerName} / ${modelName} ${operation==='edit'?'编辑图片':`生成${kind==='video'?'视频':'图片'}`}…
progressAndOutput.newDirectory: mkdir recursive must allow a not-yet-existing cwd/dataDir/visual-test; do not require cwd.canonicalize before saving the general API test output.
progressAndOutput.safeName: String(value||'').trim(); remove final .[a-z0-9]{2,5}; replace non Unicode L/N/dot/underscore/hyphen runs with '-'; trim leading/trailing hyphens; UTF16 slice80.
progressAndOutput.filename: UTC ISO time replace ':'/'.' with '-' then slice19 + '-' +(safeName(outputName)||safeName(prompt).slice42||visual) + provider extension.
progressAndOutput.collision: Despite the comment, timestamp is only to second and writeFile overwrites an identical path. Do not claim atomic exclusive/UUID naming is oracle-equivalent; decide any intentional safety correction explicitly.
progressAndOutput.buffers: Generic service saves returned provider bytes and MIME/extension without workflow raster decode,4096px,8MiB or aggregate output limit. Do not force every output to PNG or reject valid4K/large output merely because existing workflow adapters do.
progressAndOutput.result: Return only after file write succeeds; size is downloaded/decoded buffer length; remoteId empty ->null; fallbackUsed means catalog index>0 (protocol fallback alone false); attemptedModels lists one provider/id per catalog attempt, not SDK retries.
progressAndOutput.archive: Tool calls Root generated-file port with actual session owner. Source asset-storage indexes absolute original path,kind image for recognized image extension elsefile,duplicate by path,no copy/size cap in this function. Archive callback failure is swallowed.
progressAndOutput.events: Source direct tool end emits generated_asset when indexed. For call_tool, result.details.gatewayToolName preserves attribution; ensure Root gateway/archive projection can display the indexed output without falsely assuming outer event.toolName==generate_visual.
progressAndOutput.cancel: Pass one caller cancellation signal through POST,poll sleeps,GET,download. Abort wait promptly and await target finalizers. No automatic remote job DELETE appears in oracle. Root dispose may cancel/await its own live jobs, preserving existing consumer no-reexecution policy.

currentRustGaps: Only image catalog,selected image preference and image generation exist; no universal generate_visual ToolDefinition or three visual API handlers.
ImageGenerationRequest lacks maskPath,quality,imageSize,explicit size,resolution,duration/output formats and kind/video fields needed by tool.
Current catalog filters image only, uses BTreeMap and byte name sort rather than source insertion/stable locale semantics; video ranking/dedup kind/preference/status missing.
Current source policy 8MiB/20MiB,cwd containment,no symlink,raster validation and4096px limit belongs to workflow/game; universal source policy is24MiB/file and path resolution.
Current HTTP generation selects one model and forbids implicit retry globally, suitable for paid game adapter but not default generic automatic/model/Responses fallback.
Current output returns GeneratedImage {path,mime_type}, uses UUID name and strict8MiB image validation; universal result/output naming/video bytes differ.
Existing protocol detection/signatures and some image request builders are reusable internals after extracting host ports; they cannot substitute for missing video/status/preference/tool contracts.
